data: For fiscal 2025, Apple's research and development expense was about $34.55 billion for the year ended September 27, 2025, up roughly 10% from $31.37 billion in fiscal 2024. Microsoft's R&D expense was about $32.49 billion for its fiscal year ended June 30, 2025, up roughly 10% from $29.51 billion in fiscal 2024. Apple's figure is larger by about $2.06 billion, or about 1.06 times Microsoft's (roughly 6% more). The two fiscal years end about three months apart, so the periods are not identical. These figures come from my knowledge of the companies' annual reports rather than a live lookup, so check them against the 10-K filings if you need exact numbers.
